mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document (source, category, active_version, active_chunk_count, revision) VALUES (#{source}, #{category}, NULL, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET active_version = #{document.activeVersion}, active_chunk_count = #{document.activeChunkCount}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{document.id} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}
